name: F1_asof_static_left_right_change_off_its_columns
description: Task 12.1, F1. An as-of join with an exact match column, a static left table and a refreshing right table that reports a change touching neither the match column nor the stamp (here the right table is itself an as-of result, whose joined column J3 changes when the row of r goes). Java fails o4 in that cycle (ArrayIndexOutOfBoundsException in RightIncrementalHashedAsOfJoinStateManager#addToSequentialBuilder); Oxhaven keeps o4, which no change of J3 can alter.
